visualCharacteristics.layout: one slide visible at a time; image on the left (~50%), text on the right; chevron prev/next arrows at the sides (900px+) and dot indicators centred below; swipe/scroll-snap on mobile with the image stacked above the text
visualCharacteristics.imageTreatment: default: contained image (e.g. phone screenshot) on white; panel: photo fills its half
visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: white / light-grey panel, dark text, gold CTA
visualCharacteristics.purpose: image + text feature slides (product updates, app FAQ)

optionLayouts.panel: the text side sits in a light-grey panel (var(--light-color)) with generous padding; image covers its half at full slide height

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide, 2 cells: [picture] | [eyebrow p, H2, paragraph(s) or ul, optional CTA link]
